title: Lasagna Trifecta Delizioso di Scerbo
description: A rich three-meat lasagna layered with marinara, béchamel, and a blend of cheeses.

steps.instruction: Cook ground lamb, pork sausage, and beef separately until mostly done, reserving fat.
Cook vegetables in a large pot using the reserved fat (add butter if needed).
Add marinara sauce to vegetables, heat, then add cooked meats.
Cook lasagna noodles until just before al dente, then shock in ice water (skip if using oven-ready noodles).
Make béchamel by melting butter and flour to form a light roux.
Slowly add milk and heat until thickened and nearly boiling.
Season béchamel with salt and pepper.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a baking dish.
Layer noodles, a small amount of sauce, béchamel, and cheeses.
Repeat layering, alternating noodle direction each layer.
Finish with a top layer of cheese.
